summary: Creates a SOP input connector inside a component so external SOP geometry can feed the component's internal network.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Pop-up hover label shown on the component input.

common_gotchas: Component input order is alphanumeric, so naming changes can reorder ports.
In SOP does not create geometry; it only exposes geometry entering the component boundary.
Use clear labels when a component has multiple SOP inputs.
key_concepts: In SOP creates a SOP input connector inside a component.
Component inputs are ordered alphanumerically on the left side of the parent component.
The only documented custom parameter is `label`, used as the component input hover label.
In SOP exposes boundary geometry input; it does not generate geometry by itself.
